text: ICO investors have no preemptive rights or other anti-dilution protections, so they may be diluted if promoters later issue more reserve tokens to additional investors.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Initial Coin Offerings The Top 25 Jurisdictions and Their Comparative Regulatory Responses (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3117224

isBasedOn.name: Initial Coin Offerings The Top 25 Jurisdictions and Their Comparative Regulatory Responses

abstract: ICO investors have no preemptive rights or other anti- dilution protections. If the promoters decide to issue more reserve tokens to additional investors, the ICO investors may be diluted in the future.
